title: Thai Spicy Omelette
description: A spicy and savory Thai-inspired omelette with a kick of heat.

ingredients.name: spicy
ingredients.notes: Thai red chili flakes or sriracha

instructions: 1. Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together.
2. Add the spicy chili flakes, chopped cilantro, garlic, fish sauce, coconut milk, salt, and pepper to the bowl and mix well.
3. Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and add the vegetable oil.
4. Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook until the edges start to set.
5. Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
6. Continue cooking and folding until the eggs are almost set.
7. Use the spatula to carefully slide the omelette onto a plate.
